Stats.intro: Open data on Bulgaria's public sports facilities, aggregated by municipality and sport. Every published number reconciles with a direct database query.
Stats.metaDescription: Bulgaria's public sports facilities by municipality and sport: counts, access, lighting, verification status.
Stats.sourceData: Facility data is based on OpenStreetMap (ODbL licence) — © OpenStreetMap contributors.
Stats.sourcePopulation: Municipality population is from NSI (2021 Census) and currently covers the largest cities only; for the rest, "per 10,000 residents" shows n/a.
Stats.verificationNote: "Awaiting verification" are automatically imported records not yet human-confirmed — the count is high before community verification begins.
Stats.computationNote: Percentages use a clear denominator (e.g. % lit = lit / those with known lighting). When the denominator is unknown or zero we show n/a — never interpolated.
Stats.downloadComingSoon: The open-data portal (CSV/GeoJSON, API) is coming in a later stage.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: SportKarta is a non-profit project. We collect as little data as possible and do not track users.
Privacy.storeBody: We store data about sports facilities (location, type, condition) and moderator-approved photos with metadata stripped. Browsing the map needs no account and creates no profile.
Privacy.accountsBody: If you create an account we store your email address, the display name and city you enter, and whether you are under 18. A date of birth is used once to determine the age category and is not recorded anywhere. Session IP addresses are not stored. You can delete your account yourself from the "My profile" page — the profile and email are gone for good, while your contributions stay in the open dataset but anonymised, as "former user". The edit audit log is kept with no link to your identity, so the history of the data stays traceable.
Privacy.analyticsBody: We use self-hosted, cookieless analytics (Umami). We do not build profiles or track individuals across sites.
Privacy.reportsBody: Facility reports are anonymous — we neither ask for nor store a name, email, or account. For spam protection your IP address is used transiently, only to rate-limit requests, and is never stored together with the report.
Privacy.photosBody: Photograph the facility, not people. All metadata, including EXIF GPS, is stripped server-side before storage, and photos are reviewed by a moderator before publication.
Privacy.dataBody: Facility data is based on OpenStreetMap (ODbL) and the basemap on Protomaps. Community contributions are published as part of the combined open dataset.
Privacy.contactIntro: Have a question about the data, or want a record corrected or removed?
Privacy.contactFallback: Use the “Report a problem” button on the relevant facility page.
